objects.name: Detection technique coverage: silentcleanup-uac-bypass
objects.description: The following analytic detects suspicious modifications to the registry that may indicate a UAC (User Account Control) bypass attempt via the SilentCleanup task. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on registry changes in the path "*\\Environment\\windir" with executable values.
